title: Uniqlo x Cecilie Bahnsen fall/winter 2026 fleece collection (the pair's second collaboration) goes on sale in India on Fri 27 Nov 2026 online (uniqlo.com/in) and at four Uniqlo stores (Ambience Mall Vasant Kunj, Ambience Mall Gurgaon, Phoenix Palladium Mumbai, Phoenix Marketcity Bengaluru), per Uniqlo India's site; women's fleece jacket ₹3,990; fleece jackets, vests, skirts, knit gloves, fleece hats in black, dark navy, heather grey, pale pink; kids' range with peplum tops and A-line skorts
